name: CharacterEval
intro: CharacterEval 是一个中文角色扮演对话智能体评测基准，包含 77 个来自中文小说和剧本的角色、1785 个多轮对话和 11376 个样本，用于系统评估角色一致性、对话能力与角色扮演吸引力。
org: Renmin University of China, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Tianjin University, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, KAUST
build_method: GPT-4初始对话提取, 人工质量控制, 百度百科角色档案补全
metric: Fluency, Coherency, Consistency, Knowledge Exposure/Accuracy/Hallucination, Persona Behavior/Utterance, Human-likeness, Communication Skills, Expression Diversity, Empathy, MBTI Accuracy
task_type: 角色扮演对话智能体评测
eval_feature: 多轮对话, 角色一致性, 情感价值
intro_en: CharacterEval is a Chinese benchmark for role-playing conversational agent assessment, covering 77 characters, 1,785 multi-turn dialogues, and 11,376 examples.
build_method_en: GPT-4 initial dialogue extraction, human-led quality control, Baidu Baike character-profile enrichment
metric_en: Fluency, Coherency, Consistency, Knowledge Exposure/Accuracy/Hallucination, Persona Behavior/Utterance, Human-likeness, Communication Skills, Expression Diversity, Empathy, MBTI Accuracy
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn Dialogue, Character Consistency, Emotional Engagement

flowchart LR

drawio_review_note: Aligned with ACL 2024 paper 2024.acl-long.638. The diagram preserves four collection principles; GPT-4 plot-twist segmentation; GPT-4 extraction of utterances, behaviors, and scenes; ABAB two-character structure and more-than-five-turn filtering; human coherence and quality review; Baidu Baike profiles and MBTI labels; the paper-version 77 characters, 1,785 conversations, and 11,376 examples split by examples; profile-plus-context role-playing inference; sparse five-point judgments from 12 annotators used to train Baichuan2-13B-base CharacterRM; the exact twelve subjective metrics across conversational ability, character consistency, and role-playing attractiveness; and MBTI personality back-testing as the thirteenth metric. The official repository README now reports 23,020 examples, but the diagram intentionally follows the ACL paper version requested here.
